caption:
Friday's Sky is Yin Metal, The Jewel 💎 Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's polished jewel meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yin Metal gets a friend day, Yin Earth gets a joy day, Yin Wood feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

How does your Friday look? Comment your element below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #fridayfeeling #zodiacsigns #fiveelements #chineseastrology #personalgrowth #metaphysics #selfawareness #singapore
day_line: A jewel on a Rabbit day. Polished and gentle: good for fine work and kind words, easy to fuss over details.

lines.Yang Wood: Your Friday effort gets noticed. Send the wrap-up email before 5.
lines.Yin Wood: Small details nag you today. Fix the top two and log off on time.
lines.Yang Fire: Sort the weekend budget today. Then spend it happily, no guilt.
lines.Yin Fire: A nice surprise lands today. Say yes if it fits your weekend.
lines.Yang Earth: You've got good advice today. Offer it once, then let them decide.
lines.Yin Earth: Friday feels sweet for you. Book the dessert place everyone keeps mentioning.
lines.Yang Metal: Someone wants the last word today. Let them have it; you have the facts.
lines.Yin Metal: Your people share your taste today. Plan a Friday dinner somewhere pretty.
lines.Yang Water: A friend helps you sort something today. Buy them bubble tea after.
lines.Yin Water: A quiet thought turns useful today. Jot it down on the MRT home.
